001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import org.clafer.frontend.SourceSpan;
004
005import org.clafer.common.Check;
006
007/**
008 * A concrete Clafer.
009 *
010 * @author jimmy
011 */
012public class AstConcreteClafer extends AstClafer {
013
014    private final AstClafer parent;
015    private Card card = new Card();
016
017    AstConcreteClafer(String name, AstAbstractClafer claferClafer) {
018        super(name, claferClafer);
019        this.parent = null;
020    }
021
022    AstConcreteClafer(String name, AstClafer parent, AstAbstractClafer claferClafer) {
023        super(name, claferClafer);
024        this.parent = Check.notNull(parent);
025    }
026
027    /**
028     * Checks if this Clafer has a parent. Every Clafer has a parent except for
029     * the special Clafer at the root of the hierarchy.
030     *
031     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer has a parent,
032     * {@code false} otherwise
033     */
034    @Override
035    public boolean hasParent() {
036        return parent != null;
037    }
038
039    /**
040     * Returns this Clafer's parent.
041     *
042     * @return this Clafer's parent
043     */
044    @Override
045    public AstClafer getParent() {
046        return parent;
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * Returns this Clafer's cardinality.
051     *
052     * @return this Clafer's cardinality
053     */
054    public Card getCard() {
055        return card;
056    }
057
058    /**
059     * Set this Clafer's cardinality.
060     *
061     * @param card the cardinality
062     * @return this Clafer
063     */
064    public AstConcreteClafer withCard(Card card) {
065        this.card = Check.notNull(card);
066        return this;
067    }
068
069    /**
070     * Set this Clafer's low cardinality and set the high cardinality to
071     * unbounded.
072     *
073     * @param low the low group cardinality
074     * @return this Clafer
075     */
076    public AstConcreteClafer withCard(int low) {
077        return withCard(new Card(low));
078    }
079
080    /**
081     * Set this Clafer's cardinality.
082     *
083     * @param low the low cardinality
084     * @param high the high cardinality
085     * @return this Clafer
086     */
087    public AstConcreteClafer withCard(int low, int high) {
088        return withCard(new Card(low, high));
089    }
090
091    @Override
092    public AstConcreteClafer at(SourceSpan span) {
093        super.at(span);
094        return this;
095    }
096
097    @Override
098    public AstConcreteClafer withGroupCard(Card groupCard) {
099        super.withGroupCard(groupCard);
100        return this;
101    }
102
103    @Override
104    public AstConcreteClafer withGroupCard(int low) {
105        return withGroupCard(new Card(low));
106    }
107
108    @Override
109    public AstConcreteClafer withGroupCard(int low, int high) {
110        return withGroupCard(new Card(low, high));
111    }
112
113    @Override
114    public AstConcreteClafer extending(AstAbstractClafer superClafer) {
115        super.extending(superClafer);
116        return this;
117    }
118
119    @Override
120    public AstConcreteClafer refTo(AstClafer targetType) {
121        super.refTo(targetType);
122        return this;
123    }
124
125    @Override
126    public AstConcreteClafer refToUnique(AstClafer targetType) {
127        super.refToUnique(targetType);
128        return this;
129    }
130}
